title: Sales Taught Me More UX Than Any Course
excerpt: Nothing tests an interface like explaining it to a customer who's already annoyed.
body:
Selling products face to face, you learn quickly that people don't read. They scan, guess, and leave if the guess is wrong.

Every confusing label I had to explain at the counter is a confusing label I now refuse to ship.

Watch one real person use your app before you argue about it in a meeting. Cheapest user research there is.
